description:
If notebook tools fail with BRIDGE_NOT_PAIRED, call get_pairing_credentials to begin pairing (the response includes a one-click URL to show the user; authentication runs in the browser, the bridge never sees credentials). Once paired, call get_workspace_state at the start of every notebook turn; the digest of edits since your last fetch is in get_recent_user_actions.

Return the digest of user edits to the notebook since your last fetch (or session start). Use this to detect that the user changed something the agent might want to react to. Coalesced — multiple typing events on the same cell collapse to a single 'edited' entry.
name: get_recent_user_actions
